[[Siege Golem Blueprint (purple)|Siege Golem Blueprint]]s (formerly "Omega Siege Golem Blueprints") were originally used to construct [[Omega Siege Golem]]s.

These blueprints have been discontinued, replaced with [[Siege Golem Blueprint]]s. Old blueprints can be traded 1:1 for the new blueprints via Siege Master NPCs.

== Acquisition ==
=== Contained in ===
* Historically contained in achievement chests and [[Siege Blueprint Case]]s.
